A specification discussion checklist

Bring the right questions to the project team.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Confirm the exact model

Request the current product sheet and installation instructions for the proposed model. Confirm dimensions, mounting support, connection requirements and compatible components.

02

Coordinate the disciplines

Have the appropriate project professionals review drainage, access, wall construction and applicable local requirements. A marketing page is not a substitute for project drawings or approval.

03

Document the decision

Retain the selected model reference, installer’s scope, care instructions and any product-specific confirmations. Resolve open questions before ordering rather than at installation.
